properties.description:
Basic one-hop external context and double-click focus are delivered with the plan-review preparation. Validate and complete them against the approved model, navigation history and real execution cases. 

Double-click focuses; expand stays in current scope. Include every immediate external predecessor and successor crossing any internal boundary, with multiple incoming/outgoing branches and exact internal endpoints. Stop at one external hop and offer navigation/counts for further connections. Deduplicate external tasks while retaining all genuine relations. Preserve breadcrumbs, zoom, scroll, selection and expansion on Back. Cover external-to-parent, external-to-child, several entries/exits, shared external neighbour and unrelated external branches. No single-entry/single-exit assumption. Critical criteria 2, 7, 9–10, 14.
properties.title: Complete focused graph navigation for the approved model
